text.p: Research Inc said Friday its directors voted a special dividend of $0.20 a share be paid on May 1 to shareholders of record on March 28.
The dividend is a distribution from part of a gain from the sale of the company's Dimension product line in September 1996 and the sale of undeveloped land in its fiscal 1997 first quarter.

Earlier today, Research reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended December 31, 1996 amounted to $685,877 or $0.58 a share including a gain of about $1.1 million from sale of some undeveloped land.
In other action, Research directors approved payment of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 a share on April 1, record February 28.
Research designs and makes industrial electronic controls and radiant heating equipment.
